pricing_rule.scope: Only the ordinary Wednesday/Thursday dates 2026-10-21 and 2026-10-22; not a general holiday calendar or pricing engine
pricing_rule.historical_rate_check: Both rate tuples occur in the original supplier CSV. No current-rate rewrite of supplier rows.

classification_method: Join consume and timing by root hash, verify the sole successful attempt request/reservation/source/model, and join the corresponding consume ledger by reservation hash; usage agrees across both stores. Classify the entire half-open interval from request entry to max(handler finish + 1ms, ledger insertion + 1ms, consume-log Unix second + 1 second), checking every tariff transition, not just the two endpoints. The exclusive upper bound includes settlement/logging delay and timestamp truncation; a 13:59:59 log yields <14:00:00, not an event at 14:00. No request crosses a transition. This fixes the tariff band without inventing an exact upstream send timestamp.

maintainer_clarifications.other_computer: Timer was only scheduled and never actually executed; no execution, coverage or final-watermark artifacts are expected from it.
maintainer_clarifications.online_recorded_prices: Maintainer confirms recorded online prices uniformly use a peak-price baseline; this is a configuration basis, not a claim that all actual calls occurred at peak time.

cost_basis: independent retrospective CNY tariff recomputation against provider_reported CSV; not a frozen-at-execution CNY estimate or invoice
